flags.why: This kinship usage belongs to North Central Vietnam, which is part of the Central region, so the Northern tag is misleading ([Wiktionary](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/trượng)).
The food meaning is used chiefly in Central and Southern Vietnamese and needs regional labels.
The verb has a literary register that the untagged entry fails to convey ([Vietnamese dictionary](https://www.rung.vn/dict/vn_vn/Hoài_niệm)).
